steps.cmd: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c 'import pathlib,unittest; assert all(pathlib.Path(p).is_file() for p in ["src/score.py","README.md","tests/test_score.py"]); s=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover("tests"); flatten=lambda x: sum([flatten(t) if isinstance(t,unittest.TestSuite) else [t] for t in x], []); cases=flatten(s); assert s.countTestCases()==6; assert len({t.id() for t in cases})==6; assert {t._testMethodName for t in cases}=={"test_empty","test_single","test_multiple","test_zero","test_negative","test_boolean"}; r=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(s); assert r.testsRun==6 and r.wasSuccessful() and not r.skipped and not r.expectedFailures'
